chunks: And al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them:
Regarding a man who falls onto another man and kills him, he said: “There is nothing upon him.”

key_terms.لَا شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ: there is no liability upon him

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man falls onto another person and kills him accidentally?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a case in which a man falls onto another man and causes his death. The Imam عليهما السلام states that no liability is upon him, indicating the absence of blood money or legal penalty in this circumstance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5186 - Al-Alaa narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them) regarding a man who accidentally falls onto another man and kills him.
Imam (as) said: "There is nothing upon him (no liability)."
